properties.description: What sys:time-history PRESENTS: epochs, snapshots, schedules and the planned-versus-delivered delta. ONE of its five modules is reachable from outside — `temporal` — and the other four (compare, merge, readiness, alternatives) are internal. That 1-of-5 ratio is what makes this subsystem an actual black box rather than a label: the face is narrow and the inside is hidden.
properties.name: Temporal API
